title: 解約できない
body:
解約方法が分かりにくく、問い合わせにも返信がありません

B25 DRAMAのウェブ版で課金した件についてのレビューです。

解約したいのですが、手続きが分かりにくく、解約をお願いするメールを複数回送っても、現時点で返信がありません。解約が完了しているのか確認できず、今後も請求が続くのではないかと不安です。

また、ウェブ版とアプリ版のアカウントや課金の関係も分かりにくく、利用者が迷わず解約できる案内が必要だと感じます。

広告を出すだけでなく、契約後の問い合わせや解約にも、きちんと対応していただきたいです。早急な解約手続きと、解約完了の連絡を求めます。Unclear Cancellation Process and No Response to My Emails

This review concerns a payment I made through the web version of B25 DRAMA.

I would like to cancel my subscription, but the cancellation process is unclear. I have sent multiple emails requesting cancellation and have not received a response. I cannot confirm whether my subscription has been canceled, and I am worried that I may continue to be charged.

The relationship between accounts and payments on the web version and the app is also confusing. Clear instructions are needed so users can easily cancel their subscriptions.

In addition to running advertisements, please provide proper customer support and respond to cancellation requests. I request that you cancel my subscription promptly and send me confirmation that the cancellation is complete.

ユーザーの方が作ってる？って心配してしまうくらい、どんどん使いづらくなってます。

title: Title: Interesting tool, definitely takes some practice to master
body:
I’ve been testing out Necrophonic for a few sessions now, and it’s definitely a unique experience. After using it for about 20-30 minutes, I’ve found that the sound banks are really well-mastered, which helps create a distinct atmosphere compared to other standard white-noise apps. I appreciate the ability to adjust the scan rate, though it definitely takes a bit of patience to differentiate between the layered audio clips and potential responses.
It’s not an "instant answer" type of app—you really have to be dedicated to the process and spend time listening closely to the audio. I’d recommend using headphones to pick up the finer details, especially when the reverb is on. It’s a fun, professional-feeling utility for anyone interested in EVP research, though I do wish there was a built-in recording feature so I didn't have to use a second device to capture my sessions. Overall, a solid $10 investment if you're serious about your paranormal investigations.

title: Genuinely atmospheric

I also appreciated the mute switch warning it's a small detail, but it saved me a few minutes of wondering why I couldn't hear anything. Whether you believe in the paranormal or just enjoy the spooky atmosphere for entertainment, it’s a well-designed tool that feels much more intentional than the generic ghost-box apps usually found on the store. title: Good way to save money but app is borderline broken
body:
It has good deals to use like the free fries with any drink deal. But the problem is the app doesn’t run well at all. Freezes up for like 20 seconds on open. Then freezes up when selecting a restaurant/location. And sometimes even glitches your order. 


Today I went into McDonald’s to use that fries deal and the kiosk inside let me use the app code, then broke when I used my fries deal. (The screen for selecting what size fries after you pick ur drink was completely blank. Couldn’t finish the order) 

I thought oh cool no biggie I’ll just do it at the register. Only to find out even though no order was placed it still took my fries deal and wanted to make me wait 15 minutes to use another offer. 


It shouldnt be this difficult to order fast food. just fix the app functionality or let use your deals normally. Don’t force me to use ur broken app or pay 100% more for my order.


Literally every other fast food app works fine and doesn’t drain my battery the way this one does


Edit: it’s been years with this glitch and it’s still happening to me if I’m stupid enough to try and use the self checkout kiosk. McDonald’s for the love of god fix this app I’m not gunna wait 15 minutes just to be able to place an order at a fast food place

title: Delivery Scam
body:
0/5 Stars — Terrible Delivery Experience!

McDonald’s delivery through their own app has become a complete scam! Out of my last four deliveries, more than 40% of the items I ordered were missing. This is absolutely unacceptable, especially considering the delivery fees and other charges customers pay.

To make matters worse, the restaurant never answers the phone when you try to call about missing items. You pay for food you never receive, and there’s no accountability or customer service.

This isn’t a one-time mistake anymore. It’s a repeated problem, and McDonald’s needs to take responsibility. Extremely frustrating and disappointing. I would strongly recommend avoiding delivery through the McDonald’s app until they fix these issues.
